items.title: Late goal rescues a draw in the derby
items.description: A stoppage time header levelled a tense local derby. The home manager praised the side for refusing to give up after going behind early.

items.title: British sprinter breaks national indoor record
items.description: A personal best of 6.52 seconds in the 60m final set a new national mark. The athlete said the time came as a surprise after a minor injury scare.

items.title: Cricket: openers put hosts in command on day two
items.description: A century stand set up a commanding first innings total. The visitors face a difficult final session under cloud.

items.title: Rugby union: injury worries ahead of autumn series
items.description: Two first choice forwards are doubtful for the opening international. The head coach said a squad update would follow on Thursday.

items.title: Tennis: qualifier stuns seed in straight sets
items.description: The world number 240 won 6-3 6-4 to reach the quarter finals of the indoor event. She will face the home favourite next.

items.title: Cyclist wins mountain stage after solo breakaway
items.description: Attacking 40km from the finish, the rider held off the chasing group by 50 seconds. The overall leader retained the jersey.

items.title: Netball side secure place in the final
items.description: A strong third quarter turned the semi final and sent the team through. The coach credited defensive work in the circle.

items.title: Golf: late birdie run gives leader two shot cushion
items.description: Three birdies in the last four holes moved the overnight leader clear. Weather permitting, the final round starts at nine.

items.title: Swimming: relay team qualify for world finals
items.description: The mixed relay lowered the national record in the heats. Coaches said the team still has time left in the tank.

items.title: Football: club announces new stadium plans
items.description: Plans for a 30,000 seat ground were presented to supporters. Construction would begin subject to planning approval.
